description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates the use of AnimationDrawable to create a keyframe animation with frames showing a gray background and frame number text. It includes methods to generate frame bitmaps and handles user interaction to start/stop the animation.

classes.name: KeyframeAnimation
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating keyframe animation using AnimationDrawable, with user interaction to toggle animation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the animation drawable with frames, and sets click listener to toggle animation.

methods.name: getDrawableForFrameNumber
methods.description: Creates a BitmapDrawable with a gray background and text indicating the frame number.
